narration: There is a chamber in the west that holds no light and gives nothing back.
phenomenon: {hollowfour} extreme close, the seam line where the slab meets the arch, one hard line of shadow across the stone face, cold raking light
subject: cold open: the sealed mouth

narration: Three of its neighbours stand open. This one is shut, and shut on purpose.
phenomenon: {hollowfour} close low angle, the unbroken slab flush in its arch, the bare dry wall around it, hard cold light
subject: cold open: the sealed mouth

narration: One piece of stone, cut to fill the arch exactly, meant to hold forever.
phenomenon: {hollowfour} extreme close on the flush join of slab and arch, fine tool marks catching a low cold light
subject: cold open: the sealed mouth

narration: The old accounts say a living man was carried here and made to look at it.
phenomenon: {enochman} medium from behind, standing small before the sealed arch with {tablet} under one arm, cold light falling past him onto the stone
subject: cold open: the witness at the arch

narration: His name was Enoch. The mountain stands in the west. The chambers are four.
phenomenon: {westmountain} wide, the four arched openings ranged along the base, one small robed figure standing before the last of them
subject: cold open: the witness at the arch

narration: Stand back far enough and the mountain shows you what it is. A keeping place.
phenomenon: {westmountain} extreme wide high angle, the whole sheared face and the four mouths in a row, bare swept stone running to the frame edge
subject: cold open: the keeping place revealed

narration: Every person who has ever died is waiting behind one of those four doors.
phenomenon: {hollowthree} wide from the chamber mouth, the standing crowd facing one direction in cold even light, hard shadow at their feet
subject: cold open: the waiting crowd

narration: Three of the four will open on the appointed day. One of them will not.
phenomenon: {archface} wide, the four arches in a row, three catching a pale warm light and the fourth holding its dark
subject: cold open: three lit one dark

narration: The road to that answer runs west, out past the edge of the made world.
phenomenon: {upland} extreme wide, one small figure walking alone toward a bright western horizon, long morning shadow behind him
subject: cold open: the road west begins

narration: And like every road in the old world, it begins with a man holding a stone.
phenomenon: {enochhome} medium, the low dwelling alone on its dry upland in plain strong morning daylight, the one dark doorway waiting
subject: cold open: the road west begins

narration: One of them notices him, and stops, and becomes a man.
phenomenon: {fireplain} medium two-shot, {burningmen} motionless and turned toward {enochman}, the flame resolving into the shape of a human figure, hard orange light across the man's face
subject: the burning men take human shape

narration: Behind them the ground rises into mountains he has no name for.
phenomenon: {firewater} extreme wide, a range of black rock mountains ranged against a dark sky, their flanks bare and glassy, one distant orange glow low on the largest
subject: a river of fire pours down a mountainside

narration: Where the two of them meet, at the western end, the air is white.
phenomenon: {steamshore} extreme wide, an enormous white wall of steam risen along a dark coastline, backlit and glowing, the sea flat and dark beneath it
subject: fire meets the cold sea in steam

narration: The seventh one is in the centre and it is taller than the six.
phenomenon: {thronepeak} extreme wide low angle, one white mountain posted at the centre of the group and rising far above the others, cold pale light on its upper slopes
subject: the throne-mountain shows its summit

narration: And then, out in the middle of all that nothing, there is light.
phenomenon: {starprison} extreme wide, seven points of burning light hanging in a vast open dark, small and far off, their glow the only illumination in the frame
subject: seven stars burn bound in the pit

narration: There is a second place, further on, and Uriel takes him to it.
phenomenon: {angelprison} wide from behind, two figures walking toward an enormous dark break in the ground, orange light rising out of it onto their backs
subject: columns of fire fall into the second cleft

narration: The new one does not explain himself, and they start walking west again.
phenomenon: {westmountain} wide from behind, {guidetwo} leading and {enochman} following across bare dark ground, low hard light throwing both shadows forward
subject: the mountain of hard rock stands in the west

narration: At the foot of it, the one who replaced Uriel finally speaks.
phenomenon: {archface} medium two-shot, {guidetwo} and {enochman} halted at the base of a sheared rock wall, cold light falling down the face onto both
subject: the new guide gives his name

narration: The third one is where the voice has been coming from all along.
phenomenon: {hollowthree} extreme wide, a great chamber of smooth grey rock packed with standing figures all turned toward the entrance, cold even light from the mouth
subject: the third chamber holds the ones who were killed

narration: He comes to the fourth last and stops, because it is not an opening.
phenomenon: {hollowfour} wide, an arched shape cut into the rock face and filled flush with unbroken stone, cold light raking across the flat surface
subject: the fourth is sealed and none are raised
